Canada’s healthcare sector is under significant pressure. With rising demand for services, an aging population, and increasing retirements among healthcare workers, employers across the country are struggling to fill critical roles. Hospitals, long-term care homes, clinics, and community health programs are all affected. While domestic recruitment efforts continue, many employers are turning to international hiring to meet their workforce needs.
